title: Board of Ethics full-time staff
summary: The ethics office gave 180 formal advisory opinions in its first year, its director said on September 10. A full-time investigator was due to start August 17, though the budget director had said the half-time post needed to become full-time. The executive director is also weighing a paralegal or legal secretary hire.

timeline.text: The director said the ethics office gave 180 formal advisory opinions in its first year.
The budget director said the Board of Ethics' half-time investigator needs to be full-time.
The board's executive director said a full-time investigator will start August 17.

timeline.text: The executive director hopes to decide on hiring a paralegal or legal secretary in the next couple of weeks.
A member reported the board voted six to zero to put off two complaints until the staffing issue is resolved.
A member said the board must create positions, find a place and set a budget so staff are ready July 1.
The chair and a member will meet with the managing director in December to talk about staffing.
A member reported that voters approved a charter amendment to give the board full-time staff.
